messages:
Maya (RevOps): Heads-up team — APAC inbound spike: ~38% unassigned leads in last hour. HubSpot -> SF handoff shows enrichment timeouts and round-robin skipping. Can we triage?
Alec (Growth): Saw that on the funnel dashboard. Any quick root cause?
Samir (Eng): From logs: HS webhook returned 429s, enrichment lambda frequently hitting 7s timeout, routing service interprets as no payload and does RR noop.
Jordan (Ops): leadbot alert at 05:04APAC: "unassigned_inbound_rate > 0.03 for pipeline=inbound" :rotating_light:
Maya (RevOps): Short-term proposal: 1) enable default_owner fallback for slow enrichment (3s TTL), 2) heartbeat probe to surface pending leads into low-priority RR, 3) add x-retry-count header and dashboard panel.
Samir (Eng): I can ship a small patch: when enrichment doesn't return by 3000ms, attach fallback_owner and mark source="fallback". Example config (will be text in PR):
```json
{"routing": {"enrichment_timeout_ms": 3000, "fallback_owner": "sdr-inbound@redwood.com"}}
```
Alec (Growth): Fine as stopgap. We need comms: banner in SF and HubSpot, plus a short playbook so SDRs know fallback means pending verification.
Jordan (Ops): For heartbeat: cron every 10s checks leads in 'pending_enrichment' > 12s and POSTs to /routing/rr?prio=low. Pseudo:
```
SELECT id FROM leads WHERE state='pending_enrichment' AND age_s > 12;
POST /routing/round_robin?priority=low
```
Maya (RevOps): Add observability: metric leads_fallback_count, leads_reassigned_within_24h, and a dashboard tile for APAC by hour. Alert if fallback_rate > 2% for > 20m.
Samir (Eng): I'll also add exponential backoff on HS webhook: attempts=4, base=500ms, max_delay=5000ms, and include x-retry-count header for tracing. PR will include tests.
Alec (Growth): Could we tag fallback assignments in SF with a note "fallback-enrichment" so we can filter in reports?
Jordan (Ops): Yep. routing will add tag meta: {"assignment_reason": "fallback-enrichment"}.
Maya (RevOps): Rollout plan: unit tests -> staging canary 10% traffic for 2h -> run synthetic slow-enrichment events -> monitor leads_reassigned_within_24h and conversion delta. If green, promote.
Samir (Eng): Targeting canary today 18:00UTC. I'll @Maya in the PR for rollout checklist.
Alec (Growth): I'll draft the banner + 1-pager explaining SLA implications and the temporary nature of fallback.
Maya (RevOps): Post-rollout follow-up: collect sample of affected lead ids, check SF ownership mapping integrity, and measure any drop in initial-contact rate.
leadbot: Incident created: "APAC enrichment latency causing unassigned leads - fallback enabled" id: INC-176850. :white_check_mark:
Jordan (Ops): Monitoring board updated. Alert rule created. Will escalate to oncall if >3% fallback for 30m.
Maya (RevOps): Thanks all — keep updates here as actions complete (PR link, banner draft, monitor link). :rocket:
